book.title: Nzaelwapx-krbz Jiszs Mz Jon Da Kcng Tqyc-kapq-pnzng

content: Kxnzrlapxpeng Sc Tzngrpe-ngrdr Kc Nabz Kxmrna.

Mz nibrde, obq-rmwible-moux, x mcx Nei Sip kc nztuo-krmle mz Newz Saeon kxmqngi, nidr badr kxnzrlapxpeng kcng siu-trtqki-esz'-nzpnu-pwx-nrade-pwx (144,000). X drtq Nei Sip x drtq Trtede nzyrtr-pnzbz mz rtrlrmztr.
X xlrx kc nzngrngr Heven, nate etu-esz'ngr apule nzyrpukr nrc x bzlrmei. X nzngrngr lcde tqxlrx nzyrlvi-krde apu-kzle nzyrnikr nqvi r gita kxkqlu.

Leplz kcng siu-trtqki-esz'-nzpnu-pwx-nrade-pwx (144,000) nzngr-ngrdr kc nabz kxmrna mrkc tqlxlvrkipx Gct, badr kxnzlung kcng pwx, x kxnzaclveng kcng nzpnu-li-nrade-pwx (24). Nabz lc tzngr-ngrdr trpnz-moungr kx ryatitr nzrngrngr, a' ngi txpwz krkcng tzxpetrpeng mz lr nrlc.

Trnzvz-nqblqlru nqmq kr lr nrlc, a' nidr leplz kx nzalqti-lzbqng mz nzapu-krdr ncblo o olvz kxnzmnc-kamelr. X nzvz-nqblq-zvzlr Nei Sip drlve ke vzkile. Leplz lcng xpetrpeng Gct mz lr nrlc, murde nayrlqpx-bekang mz nzwztr-krbzlr mz Gct x Nei Sip, da kc tqwai nzyrlqpx-beka-ngrbz mz Gct x Nei Sip nra nounc kcng ayrnrngr.
Trnzpokiaung x nqmq krdr tubqbz mz nzobqkr Gct.
Nrpa Kxmrlz Tqycpe Tqycpe
Zbz mcx kc enjrl kx lvc mrkc wq mzlilxlr, x rlem nrpa kxmrlz kc tqycpe, tqycpe mz lr nrlc, x mz nou, natq, neidu, x drtc' amrlx. Nrpa lc nrpa ngr nzaclve-angidrkr Gct.

X rpibzle mz nate kxetu mz leplz amrlx kx, “Amrlueamu Gct x glqpxamu nide, murde mzli r nzayzlu-krbzle da mz leplz dekape. Mzli lc sa nakabzle da kxmrlzting mz leplz kcng tztubq-esz'ngrng x sa na-ayrplapxle leplz kcng tzpxtxpx-ngrdr nzyrlq-angidr-krdr natqde. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, na-angioamu Gct kc tqwz-ngrde bongavz, drtc', prla, x aulzng.”

Zbz mc-moux kc enjrl krali lvc-nqblqmle enjrl kc kai, x rpile kx, “Taon kc etu, apule Bxbilon kc bqnc, kc tqrngisc zmatq kx xplr, tzmilxtxo. Nzmnckr lr Bxbilon trka. X nzangio-krdr drka' apule nzabeati-krdr nzrmwimingr, murde trnzngida-zpwxung mz nzangio-krdr Gct angidr. Leplz mz nrlc tulvzo nzaxvctr-lzbqbzng mz alwx ngrdr x opxm kx alukurnr-ngrng waen. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, Gct sa na-ayrplapxle leplz lcng amrlx.”

X mc-moux kc enjrl kratq lvcm mz nibr krkcng nzling. X etumi nate nzrpi-krde kx, “Doa kx angiole Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr kc kai x mqngrde kc tzlz x nzyrtr-kzpz mz rtrlrmzte o mz mqde kxrtc rkx ngrde, sa na-ayrplapx Gct mz nztutr-krbzlr mz Nei Sip badr enjrl kxnzmatqng. Zngya ngr drtwrde sa naxplr-esz'ngr mz nzayrplapx-krde leplz lcng. Sa na-aetqti-zlwzbzle drtqdr x sa naodati-atwrnr-ngrng mz nyr kxpq-esz'ngr ngr rplz salfz kxngc.

Trpnzngr nzyrkrpxkr nzetqkr drtqdr, krkcng tzangiolr Mrlx Kc Tqdrka'ngr x mqngrde kc tzlz, x tztwzlr rkx ngr drtqde. Nzetqkr drtqdr vztx alo, ngrlx x mz nrlckxbq, murde zsikapu ngr nzngckr nrkrdrtqdr tqvzpe tqvzpe.”
Drtwr ngrde kx nimu leplz neng Gct, kcng tzyrlq-angidrlr natqde x tzvz-nqblq-zvzlr Jiszs, na-abrtrpzmu drtwrmu bade mz nzaenzli-krmu, murde sa na-ale Gct nike pipxle.

Mz nibrde, xlr-moux kc natq Heven, rpimle bange kx, “Yro natq lcng. Abzope mzli ka, sa namrlzbz mz leplz kcng tznibqting murde nzlxngitilr Kxetu rgu.” Rpi Mqngrkxtr kx, “Eu, da angidrtx! Murde nzetqkr drtqdr kx vzpxm mz nzwztr-krbzlr mz Kraes sa nayrkrpxpe, x Gct sa narkabz badr nzmnc-zpwxngr x da kxmrlzting mz nzwztr-krbzlr bade, kxmule-esz' nike prtzbz badr.”
Nzayrlwr-lxblrngr Lr Nrlc Apule Nzrkqtrngr Nra Nounc
Mz nibrde, obq-rmwible-moux, x mcx kc dcbz kxprki. X mz dcbz lcde, wxbuom kc ncblo elr apule Jiszs, Mrlx Leplz. Laom mz narde kc kraon kx ngi gol x malele kc toki kxka x malc.

Zbz, mcx kc enjrl vzpxm Mangr-nzangiongr, x mz nate kxetu rpibzle mz ncblo kc tqwxbuom mz dcbz kx, “Mzli ka mzli r nzayrlwr-lxblrpengr leplz kxnzmrlzng ngr nrlc, da kc tqwai nzrkqtrngr nra nounc kxnzmrlz mz toki mzli kc nabrpe-ngrdr. Mz nzmu-krde lcde, ayrlwr lxblr leplz kxnztubqng ngr nrlc.”
Zbz mrlx kc tqwxbuom mz dcbz yrlqbzle toki kxka scde mz nrlc, x leplz kxnztubqng amrlx nzyrlwrtr-lxblr-pnzng.
Zbz, mc-moux kzdq kz enjrl kc tqvzpxm Mangr-nzangiongr Heven. Enjrl lc male-kzle kc toki kxka kxmalc.

X enjrl kc tqaclvele nyr ngr olta vzpxm mz olta. Rpibzle mz enjrl kc tqrmale toki kxka kxmalc kx, “Mzli ka mzli r nzayrlwr-lxblrpengr leplz ngr nrlc tulvzo kcng tzaleng alwx, da kc tqwai nzrkqtrngr nra grep mz toki mz mzli r nzrnzbrtiongr.”

Murde leplz kcng tzaleng alwx nzapulr nra grep. X enjrl kc tqayrlwr-lxblrle leplz lcng, apule ncblo kc tqrlakipx nra grep mz toki scde. X leplz lcng sc tzayrplapx-zlwzpeng mz zngya ngr drtwr Gct kc tqtubq-esz'ngr, apule nzrtcongr nra grep mz da kxetu kx narnzbrtio-ngrdr mz nzwz-krdrleng murde nangi lue.

Mzli kc tzrnzbrtiongr nra grep, lue lr nra grep kxpc yrlepx zlwz. X mz nqmq lcpwz, Gct sa na-ayrplapxle leplz ngr nrlc kcng tzaleng alwx. Sa na-apule kx rnzbrtiole nidr, x mepyr ngrdr kxpc nayrlepx kz na-apule nzyrlepxkr lue lr nra grep. X me nakrlzbz nubla ngr mepyr ngrdr takitr kilomita kx trtqki-tq (300) x nzboo-krde krlzmle nabx ncblo, murde nzayrplapxkr Gct kxnzaleng alwx sa naetu-esz'ngr.

footnotes.text: Nzboikr nubla ngr mepyr lc apule mrka Santz Krus krlzbzle Santz Ana o Santa Krus krlzbzle Tikopia.
